backlog.spec: Change WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so more of the 300s is spent at peak LR. Keep FINAL_LR_FRAC at 0.
backlog.title: Lower warmdown ratio to 0.3

backlog.spec: Set WARMDOWN_RATIO = 0.7 to test a longer linear decay phase with the same final LR of 0.
backlog.title: Higher warmdown ratio 0.7

backlog.spec: Set WARMUP_RATIO = 0.03 to add a brief LR warmup and stabilise early Muon and Adam steps at the high embedding LR.
backlog.title: Small warmup

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**18. This gives about twice as many optimizer steps in 300s. With DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64 and seq len 2048 this is gradient accumulation of 2 microbatches. It is a standard win for short runs.
backlog.title: Halve total batch size

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 (about 131K tokens per step). Reduce MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to compensate for noisier gradients. Check that gradient accumulation still divides evenly.
backlog.title: Batch 2**17 with more steps

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 6 and ASPECT_RATIO = 96 (dim 576, 4.5 heads, so round dim to a multiple of HEAD_DIM, e.g. ASPECT_RATIO 85 gives 512). Use whatever keeps dim a multiple of 128. The goal is to test a shallower model that gets more steps in 300s.
backlog.title: Depth 6 wider model

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 10 with ASPECT_RATIO = 51 (dim about 512). Test whether extra depth beats the lost throughput in 300s. Reduce DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 if memory is tight.
backlog.title: Depth 10 narrower

backlog.spec: Raise MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 for Muon.
backlog.title: Matrix LR 0.05

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.1. The run is short, so less regularisation may help.
backlog.title: Weight decay 0.1

backlog.spec: Set WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.3 for Muon cautious weight decay.
backlog.title: Weight decay 0.3

backlog.spec: Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.4.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.4

backlog.spec: Raise EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.9.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.9

backlog.spec: Double UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.008.
backlog.title: Unembedding LR 0.008

backlog.spec: Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 for the per-layer scalars.
backlog.title: Scalar LR 0.25

backlog.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.9, 0.99). Test smoother second-moment estimates for embeddings and scalars.
backlog.title: Adam beta2 0.99 variant

backlog.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS to (0.7, 0.95) for faster momentum response in a short run.
backlog.title: Adam beta1 0.7

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "L" so every layer uses full context attention. Check the throughput cost against the quality gain.
backlog.title: Window pattern all long

backlog.spec: Set WINDOW_PATTERN = "SSL" to give more full-attention layers. The final layer is always full.
backlog.title: Window pattern SSSSL variant

backlog.spec: Set FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05 so the LR does not reach exactly zero at the end of warmdown.
backlog.title: Final LR fraction 0.05

backlog.spec: In the Muon momentum schedule, shorten the ramp from 0.85 to 0.95 to 150 steps, or lengthen it, whichever is currently the other way. Also raise final momentum to 0.97 during warmdown.
backlog.title: Muon momentum warmup shorter

backlog.spec: Set HEAD_DIM = 64 for more attention heads at the same width. Check that flash attention and any value-embedding code still work with the new head count.
backlog.title: Head dim 64

backlog.spec: Change the logit softcap constant (currently 15 if present) to 30, or add one with tanh(x/30)*30 if absent. This tests a looser cap on the output logits.
backlog.title: Logit softcap tuning

backlog.spec: Replace the MLP activation relu(x)^2 with a gated SiLU MLP whose hidden size is 8/3 times the width, rounded to a multiple of 64, so the parameter count is unchanged. Use a single fused up-projection that is split into two halves.
backlog.title: ReLU squared to SwiGLU-lite

backlog.spec: Zero-initialise the attention output projection and MLP down projection in every block, if not already done. This makes each block the identity at the start.
backlog.title: Zero-init residual projections check

backlog.spec: Change the initial values of the per-layer residual scalars (resid_lambdas) from 1.0 to 0.9 and the x0 lambdas from 0.1 to 0.2. This tests how strongly the input embedding is mixed back into each layer.
backlog.title: Residual lambda init

backlog.spec: Check that GC is disabled after the first step (gc.freeze then gc.disable) and that the training loop does not call .item() on the loss every step. Sync only every 10 steps. This slightly increases step throughput.
backlog.title: Disable torch compile fullgraph recompiles / use bf16 autocast tweak

backlog.spec: Add torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0) before optimizer.step(). This guards against spikes at the high LR.
backlog.title: Gradient clipping at 1.0

backlog.spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine decay over the warmdown phase, using progress based on elapsed training time. Keep the final LR at FINAL_LR_FRAC.
backlog.title: Time-based cosine decay

backlog.spec: Initialise lm_head weights with std 0.001 instead of the current value, or zero if it is not already zero. Initialise the token embedding with std 0.5 if it is currently 1.0.
backlog.title: Untied smaller vocabulary-side init

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**17 (keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64, so grad accumulation is 2 steps). Change nothing else. This replicates and extends the small-batch gain from slot 11 and serves as an audit of the tripwire-flagged result. Compare the official val_bpb against the 1.0657-1.0677 range.
backlog.title: Audit slot 11 with batch 2**17 replicate

backlog.spec: Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE = 2**16 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE = 32, so there is exactly 1 micro-step per optimizer step. This gives many more optimizer steps in the 300 s budget. If Muon or Adam is unstable, scale MATRIX_LR by 0.7. Otherwise change nothing else.
backlog.title: Batch 2**16 with no gradient accumulation

backlog.spec: Set DEPTH = 4 and ASPECT_RATIO = 128, so model_dim = 512 and there are 4 heads of size 128. The shallower model should be faster per step and see more tokens in 300 s. Change nothing else.
backlog.title: Depth 4 wider model

backlog.spec: Find the Muon momentum schedule in train.py, which ramps from about 0.85 to 0.95. Change it to ramp from 0.85 to 0.95 over the first 100 steps instead of the current length. If the ramp is time-based, make it 5% of the budget. Leave everything else unchanged.
backlog.title: Muon momentum 0.9 and shorter ramp

backlog.spec: Make Muon's cautious weight decay follow the LR schedule. Multiply WEIGHT_DECAY by the same lr multiplier used in the warmdown, or by (1 - progress), each step. Start at 0.2. This reduces regularization late in training, when the model is short on steps rather than data.
backlog.title: Weight decay linearly decayed to zero

backlog.spec: Set EMBEDDING_LR = 0.9 and UNEMBEDDING_LR = 0.008 together. This tests a bolder Adam LR bump for the input and output embeddings, which suit short training. Change nothing else.
backlog.title: Embedding LR 0.9 with unembedding LR 0.008

backlog.spec: Find the logit softcap constant in the forward pass (tanh softcap, likely 15) and set it to 30. This loosens the cap on logits. If the constant is a different value, double it.
backlog.title: Logit softcap 30 instead of 15

backlog.spec: Raise the init of the per-layer x0 lambda scalars (the weights that blend the initial embedding into each layer, commonly 0.1) to 0.2. Keep the residual lambdas at 1.0. This gives layers stronger access to the token embedding in this very short run.
backlog.title: Value-embedding style skip: x0 residual mixing init

backlog.spec: If MAX_SEQ_LEN (imported from prepare) can't change, skip. Otherwise change the attention window pattern to "L" (all full context) and set DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 with TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**17. Full attention everywhere tests whether long context helps at this size. Keep the total token count per step fixed.
backlog.title: Sequence length 1024 with doubled device batch

backlog.spec: Reduce the init std of the token embedding (wte) from 1.0 to 0.5, and leave lm_head init as it is. A smaller embedding scale should give a calmer start with the high EMBEDDING_LR. Edit only the init_weights normal_ std for wte.
backlog.title: Remove value-less extra: tie init std of embeddings to 0.5

incumbent.description: Test a bolder learning rate for embeddings by increasing EMBEDDING_LR and UNEMBEDDING_LR while keeping all other hyperparameters at the incumbent values.

memo:
Helped: throughput changes under the fixed 300 s budget. Slot 6 (DEPTH 6, ASPECT_RATIO 85, dim 512) gave 1.1020, delta -0.0155. Slot 11 (halving total batch size) gave 1.0677/1.0657, delta -0.0294, but it has a tripwire flag, so audit it before building on it. Incumbent: mean_adjusted 1.0699.

Did not help: SwiGLU-lite MLP (+0.0068), sliding-window SSL (+0.0026), beta1 0.7 (+0.0013), SCALAR_LR 0.25 (+0.0014), FINAL_LR_FRAC 0.05 (+0.0039), warmup 0.03 (+0.0136), DEPTH 10 (+0.0329), HEAD_DIM 64 (+0.0029), betas (0.9, 0.99) (+0.0064), warmdown 0.3 (+0.0049), cosine decay (+0.0002). Warmdown 0.7 (-0.0015) and gradient clipping (-0.0014) were marginal, likely noise.

Next: run an audit of slot 11 first. Then try DEPTH 5 or 4 and a smaller batch again. Re-test warmdown 0.7 and clipping on the new incumbent. Use replicates for any gain under about 0.003. Skip further MLP, attention-pattern and schedule-shape changes.
